title: Set 8

sentences.ko: 혹시 몰라서 말씀드리는데, 지퍼가 좀 뻑뻑해요. 그래도 쓰는 데는 문제없어서 미리 말씀드리는 거예요.
sentences.text: Just so you know, the zipper sticks a little. It still works fine, I just wanted to be upfront about it.

alts.text: Heads up, zipper's a little sticky, but it still works fine.
I wanted to let you know the zipper sticks slightly, although it remains fully functional.

sentences.note: **upfront about it** 는 뭔가를 숨기지 않고 미리 솔직하게 말해 둘 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 솔직히 말하면, 그 색은 너한테 별로 안 어울려. 근데 핏은 진짜 예쁘니까 검정으로 사보는 게 어때.
sentences.text: Honestly, that color's not really doing it for you. The cut's great though, so maybe grab it in black instead.

alts.text: Yeah, not really your color, but the cut's amazing, so just get it in black.
To be honest, that color does not suit you particularly well, though the cut is quite flattering. You might consider it in black.

sentences.note: **doing it for you** 는 뭔가 그 사람한테 안 어울리거나 안 맞을 때 쓰는 표현입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 진짜 신발 신으려는 순간에 갑자기 비가 쏟아지기 시작했어. 내일 아침에 꼭 갈게, 약속해.
sentences.text: I was literally putting my shoes on when it just started pouring outside. I'll go tomorrow morning instead, I promise.

alts.text: I was seriously about to leave when it started pouring, so I'm going tomorrow instead.
I was just about to leave for my workout when it began raining heavily outside. I will go tomorrow morning instead.

sentences.note: **literally** 는 여기서 진짜로, 정말로 라는 뜻으로 강조할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 우리 이십 분째 넘기고 있는데 넌 아직도 못 정했잖아. 아무거나 골라, 나 진짜 뭐든 상관없어.
sentences.text: We've been scrolling for twenty minutes and you still can't decide. Just pick something, I don't care what it is.

alts.text: Been at this for ages and you still can't decide, so just pick anything.
We have been browsing for twenty minutes and you still have not decided. Please just select something, as I have no particular preference.

sentences.note: **I don't care what it is** 는 정말 아무거나 상관없다는 뜻으로 짜증 섞인 상황에 자주 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 제가 내일 아침에 회의가 있어서 슬슬 일어나야 할 것 같아요. 오늘 즐거웠습니다, 감사해요.
sentences.text: I've got an early meeting tomorrow, so I should probably head out soon. Thanks for tonight, I had a great time.

alts.text: I gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'm gonna take off. Tonight was fun, thanks.
I have an early meeting tomorrow morning, so I should be heading out now. Thank you for tonight, I had a wonderful time.

sentences.note: **head out** 은 자리에서 일어나 나간다는 뜻의 편한 표현입니다.
sentences.situation: 회식 자리에서 적당히 빠져나올 구실 만들기

reviewed: 4번 문장(넷플릭스) formal 문장에서 'nearly twenty minutes'라고 써서 원문 'twenty minutes'와 시간이 어긋나 뜻이 살짝 바뀌었습니다. 'nearly'를 빼서 원문과 맞췄습니다.
